scope: Independent read-only review of the mechanical CAD; not physical testing
result: Approved as a dimensional print prototype after socket-depth and structural corrections
final_comfort_delta: Opus recommended removing four unused outer corner legs and unused left floor spurs; Codex implemented and verified connectivity, positive joints, removed free ends and all hardware/loading clearances. No added curved bridge or underside shell.
friction_design: Opus and Codex agreed on one removable internal ring liner with the remaining rings as free guides. Physical drag and rotation resistance remain unmeasured.
export_delta: Final print STL float32 seams normalised through Manifold, less than 0.01 mm3 volume change; print projects prepare that exact normal STL.
approval_boundary: Opus approved the core CAD before the comfort cleanup, then independently recommended removing the unused outer legs/floor spurs and using a one-ring friction liner. Codex implemented those recommendations and checked the final exports. Post-cleanup STLs were not independently re-read by Opus.
